customManagers.description: The pinned upstream Bridge tag. Being silently eight releases behind is the failure this repository exists to prevent, so this manager is the point of it.
ko's base image in .goreleaser.yaml is our own Bridge image. A Bridge upgrade has to move BOTH this and the Dockerfile's ARG, or the web image ships a different Bridge than the base image does.

packageRules.description: Proton marks some releases as pre-release on GitHub while their tags look like ordinary semver (v3.27.1 was one). Take stable releases only; a pre-release can still be pinned by hand.
